title: CSL Army Service Component Command (ASCC) Program Support FY26-31
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.FDO EUSTIS.W6QM MICC-CARLISLE BARRACKS
description_text: The contractor shall participate in the preparation and conduct of courses, classes, and events; maintain teaching and subject matter currency; and serve as a Subject Matter Expert in support of research and document review. Specifically: the contractor will serve as the Primary Integrator for Army Service Component Command (ASCC) and Theater Army educational efforts at the US Army War College (USAWC). See attachments.
